---
title: "Analyzing Americans' Time Use"
author: "Genesis"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
#| label: connect-atus
#| echo: true
#| message: false

con <- dbConnect(
  duckdb(),
  dbdir = "data/atus.duckdb",
  read_only = TRUE
)

dbplyr_act <- tbl(con, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(con, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(con, "activity_codes")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| label: average-activity-minutes-by-sex
#| echo: true
#| message: false

activity_avg <- dbplyr_act |>
  left_join(
    dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name),
    by = "activity_code"
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_resp |>
      filter(
        str_starts(employment_status, "Not"),
        day_type == "Weekday"
      ) |>
      select(tucaseid, sex),
    by = "tucaseid"
  ) |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(
    daily_min = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(
    avg_daily_min = mean(daily_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| label: hourly-activity-average
#| echo: true
#| message: false

hourly_avg <- dbplyr_act |>
  left_join(
    dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name),
    by = "activity_code"
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_resp |>
      filter(
        str_starts(employment_status, "Not"),
        day_type == "Weekday"
      ) |>
      select(tucaseid, sex),
    by = "tucaseid"
  ) |>
  mutate(start_hour = floor(start_hhmm / 100)) |>
  filter(
    between(start_hour, 6, 23),
    major_name %in% c(
      "Personal Care Activities",
      "Household Activities",
      "Caring For & Helping Household (HH) Members",
      "Socializing, Relaxing, and Leisure"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(sex, major_name, start_hour) |>
  summarize(
    avg_min = mean(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect()

print(hourly_avg)
```

```{r}
#| label: average-activity-chart
#| echo: true

activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = fct_reorder(major_name, avg_daily_min, .fun = mean),
      y = avg_daily_min,
      fill = sex
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Daily Time Spent by Activity",
    subtitle = "Weekday non-employed respondents, by sex",
    x = "Major activity category",
    y = "Average daily minutes",
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: hourly-activity-area-chart
#| echo: true

ggplot(
  hourly_avg,
  aes(x = start_hour, y = avg_min, fill = major_name)
) +
  geom_area() +
  facet_wrap(vars(sex)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 6:23,
    labels = \(hour) sprintf("%02d:00", hour)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "How the Day Fills Up",
    subtitle = "Average minutes in each activity by start hour and sex",
    x = "Hour of day",
    y = "Average minutes",
    fill = "Activity category",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  )
```
